name: app.englishcue/englishcue
title: EnglishCue
description: English teaching tools: conjugation, collocations, idioms, phrasal verbs, level tests, worksheets

tools.name: search_teaching_resources
tools.description: Search EnglishCue's free English teaching pages: grammar lessons, printable worksheets, conversation questions, ESL activities and games, teaching guides, verbs, vocabulary, phrasal verbs, idioms, collocations, confusing words and level tests. Returns titles, links and summaries.

query.description: What to find, e.g. “present perfect worksheet”, “B1 conversation questions about travel”, “icebreaker games”.

tools.name: conjugate_verb
tools.description: Conjugate an English verb in every tense (simple, continuous, perfect, future, conditional), with irregular forms, British variants and the imperative. Also accepts a form like “went” or “written”.

tools.name: a_or_an
tools.description: Decide whether a word or phrase takes “a” or “an”, with the reason (silent h, “you” sound, abbreviations, numbers).

tools.name: get_collocations
tools.description: Common English collocations of a key word (make, do, take, have, get, give, keep, pay, catch, break, save, lose, spend, heavy, strong, high, deep, big, hard, time, money, attention, problem), grouped by meaning, with examples and common mistakes.

tools.name: compare_confusing_words
tools.description: Explain the difference between commonly confused English words (affect/effect, lend/borrow, make/do, say/tell…) with meanings, examples, a memory tip and practice sentences with answers.

tools.name: explain_phrasal_verb
tools.description: Meanings of an English phrasal verb, whether it is separable, synonyms, examples and notes.

phrasal_verb.description: The phrasal verb, e.g. “give up”, “look after”.

tools.name: explain_idiom
tools.description: Meaning, level, register and examples of an English idiom.

tools.name: get_vocabulary_list
tools.description: A vocabulary list for a topic and CEFR level (A1–C1) with meanings, example sentences and speaking questions, ready for an English class.

tools.name: get_level_test
tools.description: A 20-question English placement test (A2–C2) set in a profession (nurses, business, software developers, hotel staff, teachers…), with answers, explanations and scoring. Call without a profession to list them.
